# Sutura Solutions

> Sutura Solutions builds practical automation systems for small businesses in Perth, Western Australia, then trains their teams to use them.

Sutura Solutions is a Perth-based automation consultancy. We find where a business is losing time to manual admin work — quoting, lead follow-up, invoicing, scheduling — and build automated systems to handle it. We then train the client's team so the systems are actually adopted, not abandoned after handoff.

## Services

- [Build Automations](https://www.suturasolutions.com/#what-we-do): Custom automation systems for quoting, lead follow-up, invoicing, and scheduling.
- [Team Training](https://www.suturasolutions.com/#what-we-do): Hands-on training so staff can run and maintain the systems we build.

## Who we serve

Small and medium businesses in Perth, Western Australia, typically 5–50 employees, including tradies and service businesses.
